Irina-Camelia Begu (born 26 August 1990) is a Romanian tennis player. She reached a career-high WTA singles ranking of world No. 22, in August 2016. Two years later, she reached her highest ranking in doubles, also No. 22.  She is currently the No. 3 Romanian player. Begu has won six singles titles and nine doubles titles on the WTA Tour . She also has won three singles titles on the WTA Challenger Tour , with 12 singles and 19 doubles titles on the ITF Women's Circuit . As a junior, she reached the semifinals of the 2007 Wimbledon Championships , partnering with Oksana Kalashnikova . Later, as a senior, she continued with Grand Slam doubles success.
